title: OA THE PSYCHIC DUEL - the wills contest: the special circumstances, the save-versus-death resolution with the kensai bonus, and the honor awards with the loser options
audit_comment: OA round seventy-four (capture pp. 222-223): The Psychic Duel - the mental combat of the wills with the save-versus-death resolution, the kensai bonus, the three outcomes, the honor awards and the loser options, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA THE PSYCHIC DUEL, printed capture pp. 222-223 - the wills contest round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE FRAME: the psychic duel a type of mental combat practiced by any character race or class, requiring no psionic talent - the test of the wills, the invisible fight revealed by the grimace, the eyelid, the tic; the wise man admitting defeat before it occurs. THE CIRCUMSTANCES: only on or by intelligent human or humanoid creatures, strictly one-on-one - never between friends (3 points of honor), never with crossed weapons, never under outside attack: the pre-battle challenge or the swaggering bully. THE RESOLUTION: the round spent within 10 feet concentrating the will, each saving throw vs. death - the kensai +2 against non-kensai; one makes one wins, both fail inconclusive, both make locked for another round; the breaker the loser, his nerve broken. THE HONOR: 2 points beating a higher level, 1 the equal, none the lower. THE LOSER: retreat losing the equal honor, or attack at -1 on initiative, to hit and saves throughout, no surprise - both sides prepared. The prose codifies per the R431 calculus

consts.name: djaOAPsychicDuelRangeFeet
consts.comment: the psychic duel range - the characters spend the round within 10 feet of each other, concentrating their will (print capture p. 222)

consts.name: djaOAPsychicDuelKensaiBonus
consts.comment: the kensai duel bonus - kensai characters have a bonus of +2 to the saving throw vs. death roll when facing non-kensai characters (print capture p. 222)

consts.name: djaOAPsychicDuelFriendsHonor
consts.comment: the friends dishonor - the duel never used between friends or companions, such an action being highly insulting and dishonorable for both, 3 points of honor (print capture p. 222)

consts.name: djaOAPsychicDuelHigherLevelHonor
consts.comment: the higher-level honor award - the winner of a psychic duel gains 2 points of honor if his opponent is of a higher experience level than himself (print capture p. 223)

consts.name: djaOAPsychicDuelEqualLevelHonor
consts.comment: the equal-level honor award - if the two are equal level, the winner gains 1 point of honor (print capture p. 223)

consts.name: djaOAPsychicDuelLoserAttackPenalty
consts.comment: the loser attack penalty - if the loser attacks regardless of the outcome, he is -1 on his initiative, to hit, and saving throw rolls throughout the ensuing battle (print capture p. 223)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelDoctrine
bools.comment: the doctrine frame - the psychic duel a type of mental combat practiced by any character race or class, requiring no psionic talent, a test of the wills of the duelists - their courage, skill and determination, the invisible fight revealed by a faint grimace, the flicker of an eyelid, or the tic of a muscle (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelAnyoneMayTry
bools.comment: the anyone clause - although the psychic duel can be attempted by anyone, it can only be done under special circumstances (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelHumanOnly
bools.comment: the human-or-humanoid gate - it can only be used on or by intelligent creatures of human or humanoid races (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelOneOnOne
bools.comment: the one-on-one rule - it is strictly a one-on-one duel, a single character facing off against another (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelNeverFriends
bools.comment: the friends exclusion - it is never used between friends or companions, such an action being highly insulting and dishonorable for both (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelNoCrossedWeapons
bools.comment: the crossed-weapons exclusion - the characters cannot have crossed weapons before during the encounter (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelNoOutsideAttacks
bools.comment: the outside-attack exclusion - neither can it be used if they are attacked by others during the course of the psychic duel, not in the heat of a furious battle but in a challenge before the battle, or on a swaggering bully in the street (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelSaveVersusDeath
bools.comment: the resolution roll - each character rolls a saving throw vs. death (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelOneMakesOneWins
bools.comment: the split outcome - if one character makes a successful saving throw and the other does not, the successful character has won the duel (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelBothFailInconclusive
bools.comment: the inconclusive outcome - if both characters fail the saving throw, the duel is inconclusive and neither wins (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelBothMakeContinue
bools.comment: the continuation outcome - if both characters make the saving throw, they are locked in the mental battle and the duel continues for another round (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelBreakerLoses
bools.comment: the nerve-break rule - should one player break off the duel and attack before it is resolved, he is the loser, his nerve has broken (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelLoserRetreat
bools.comment: the loser retreat option - the loser may retreat, losing points of honor equal to those gained by the victor (print capture p. 223)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelLoserMayAttack
bools.comment: the loser attack option - the loser can attack regardless of the outcome of the psychic duel (print capture p. 223)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelNoSurprise
bools.comment: the no-surprise rule - no surprise roll is made after the duel, since both sides are prepared (print capture p. 223)

bools.name: djaOAPsychicDuelLowerLevelNoHonor
bools.comment: the lower-level rule - if the loser is of lower level, the winner gains no honor for the duel (print capture p. 223)
